units.source: Note tree contextual menu
units.context: Note tree contextual menu

units.source: The __TRILIUM_PH_0__note tree menu__TRILIUM_PH_1__ can be accessed by right-clicking in the __TRILIUM_PH_2__Note Tree__TRILIUM_PH_3__.
units.context: Note tree contextual menu

units.source: Interaction__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: Note tree contextual menu > Interaction

units.source: The contextual menu can operate:
units.context: Note tree contextual menu > Interaction

units.source: On a single note, by right clicking it in the note tree.
units.context: Note tree contextual menu > Interaction

units.source: On multiple notes, by selecting them first. See __TRILIUM_PH_0__Multiple selection__TRILIUM_PH_1__ on how to do so.
units.context: Note tree contextual menu > Interaction

units.source: When right clicking, do note that usually the note being right clicked is also included in the affected notes, regardless of whether it was selected or not.
units.context: Note tree contextual menu > Interaction

units.source: Available options__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: Note tree contextual menu > Available options

units.source: When multiple notes are selected, only a subset of notes will be active. The ones that do support multiple notes will mention this in the list below.
units.context: Note tree contextual menu > Available options

units.source: The most frequent actions stand side by side at the top of the menu, each as an icon over its name. Use __TRILIUM_PH_0__←__TRILIUM_PH_1__ and __TRILIUM_PH_2__→__TRILIUM_PH_3__, or __TRILIUM_PH_4__↑__TRILIUM_PH_5__ and __TRILIUM_PH_6__↓__TRILIUM_PH_7__, to move between them.
units.context: Note tree contextual menu > Available options

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Cut__TRILIUM_PH_1__
units.context: Note tree contextual menu > Available options

units.source: Will place the given notes in clipboard.
units.context: Note tree contextual menu > Available options

units.source: Use one of the two paste functions (or the keyboard shortcuts) to move them to the desired location.
units.context: Note tree contextual menu > Available options

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Copy__TRILIUM_PH_1__
units.context: Note tree contextual menu > Available options

units.source: Will place the given notes in clipboard.
units.context: Note tree contextual menu > Available options

units.source: Use one of the two paste functions (or the keyboard shortcuts) to copy them to the desired location.
units.context: Note tree contextual menu > Available options

units.source: Note that the copy function here works according to the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Cloning Notes__TRILIUM_PH_1__ functionality (i.e. the note itself will be present in two locations at once, and editing it in one place will edit it everywhere).
units.context: Note tree contextual menu > Available options

units.source: To simply create a duplicate note that can be modified independently, look for __TRILIUM_PH_0__Duplicate__TRILIUM_PH_1__.
units.context: Note tree contextual menu > Available options

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Paste into__TRILIUM_PH_1__
units.context: Note tree contextual menu > Available options

units.source: Pastes the notes in clipboard as child notes of the right-clicked one.
units.context: Note tree contextual menu > Available options

units.source: Shown only after notes have been cut or copied.
units.context: Note tree contextual menu > Available options

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Paste after__TRILIUM_PH_1__
units.context: Note tree contextual menu > Available options

units.source: Pastes the notes in clipboard underneath the right-clicked one.
units.context: Note tree contextual menu > Available options

units.source: Shown only after notes have been cut or copied.
units.context: Note tree contextual menu > Available options

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Delete__TRILIUM_PH_1__
units.context: Note tree contextual menu > Available options

units.source: Will delete the given notes, asking for confirmation first.
units.context: Note tree contextual menu > Available options

units.source: In the dialog, the following options can be configured:
units.context: Note tree contextual menu > Available options

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Delete also all clones__TRILIUM_PH_1__ to ensure that the note will be deleted everywhere if it has been placed into multiple locations (see __TRILIUM_PH_2__Cloning Notes__TRILIUM_PH_3__).
units.context: Note tree contextual menu > Available options

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Erase notes permanently__TRILIUM_PH_1__ will ensure that the note cannot be recovered from __TRILIUM_PH_2__Recent Changes__TRILIUM_PH_3__.
units.context: Note tree contextual menu > Available options

units.source: The rest of the menu lists its options one per row:
units.context: Note tree contextual menu > Available options

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Open note__TRILIUM_PH_1__
units.context: Note tree contextual menu > Available options

units.source: Clicking it opens the note in a new __TRILIUM_PH_0__tab__TRILIUM_PH_1__.
units.context: Note tree contextual menu > Available options

units.source: Hovering it or clicking its arrow opens a submenu with the places the note can be opened in: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Open in a new tab__TRILIUM_PH_1__, __TRILIUM_PH_2__Open in a new split__TRILIUM_PH_3__ (to the right of the note, within the current tab) and __TRILIUM_PH_4__Open in a new window__TRILIUM_PH_5__.
units.context: Note tree contextual menu > Available options

units.source: On mobile, the menu lists __TRILIUM_PH_0__Open__TRILIUM_PH_1__, __TRILIUM_PH_2__Open in a new tab__TRILIUM_PH_3__ and __TRILIUM_PH_4__Open in a new split__TRILIUM_PH_5__ directly instead of __TRILIUM_PH_6__Open note__TRILIUM_PH_7__, and leaves out __TRILIUM_PH_8__Open in a new window__TRILIUM_PH_9__. __TRILIUM_PH_10__Open__TRILIUM_PH_11__ shows the note in the current tab, which also opens a note with children, since tapping one lists its children instead.
units.context: Note tree contextual menu > Available options

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Quick edit__TRILIUM_PH_1__
units.context: Note tree contextual menu > Available options

units.source: Opens the note in __TRILIUM_PH_0__Quick edit__TRILIUM_PH_1__, over the current one.
units.context: Note tree contextual menu > Available options

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Hoist note__TRILIUM_PH_1__
units.context: Note tree contextual menu > Available options

units.source: Will focus the note tree on this note. See __TRILIUM_PH_0__Note Hoisting__TRILIUM_PH_1__ for more information.
units.context: Note tree contextual menu > Available options

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Insert note after__TRILIUM_PH_1__
units.context: Note tree contextual menu > Available options

units.source: Allows easy creation of a note with a specified __TRILIUM_PH_0__note type__TRILIUM_PH_1__.
units.context: Note tree contextual menu > Available options

units.source: The __TRILIUM_PH_0__Code__TRILIUM_PH_1__ submenu starts with the scripting notes, each a code note set up for its role: __TRILIUM_PH_2__Custom CSS__TRILIUM_PH_3__ (with __TRILIUM_PH_4__), __TRILIUM_PH_5__Widget__TRILIUM_PH_6__ (with __TRILIUM_PH_7__ and a starting skeleton) and __TRILIUM_PH_8__Backend script__TRILIUM_PH_9__. The enabled code languages follow.
units.context: Note tree contextual menu > Available options

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Collections__TRILIUM_PH_1__ are grouped in the __TRILIUM_PH_2__Collection__TRILIUM_PH_3__ submenu. The note types created less often, the __TRILIUM_PH_4__Snippets__TRILIUM_PH_5__ and the AI quick action are in the __TRILIUM_PH_6__More__TRILIUM_PH_7__ submenu.
units.context: Note tree contextual menu > Available options

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Templates__TRILIUM_PH_1__ will also be present (if any) at the end of the list, under a __TRILIUM_PH_2__Templates__TRILIUM_PH_3__ heading. The __TRILIUM_PH_4__ button beside the heading opens __TRILIUM_PH_5__Content Manager__TRILIUM_PH_6__ in the __TRILIUM_PH_7__Options__TRILIUM_PH_8__, where the templates can be managed.
units.context: Note tree contextual menu > Available options

units.source: To find an entry quickly, type into the search box at the top of the submenu, or just start typing while the submenu is open. The submenu then lists every matching entry, including those inside its own submenus (such as a code language or a collection), each with the submenu it comes from. Use __TRILIUM_PH_0__↑__TRILIUM_PH_1__ and __TRILIUM_PH_2__↓__TRILIUM_PH_3__ to pick a match, __TRILIUM_PH_4__Enter__TRILIUM_PH_5__ to create it, and __TRILIUM_PH_6__Esc__TRILIUM_PH_7__ to clear the search.
units.context: Note tree contextual menu > Available options

units.source: The note will be added on the same level of hierarchy as the note selected.
units.context: Note tree contextual menu > Available options

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Insert child note__TRILIUM_PH_1__
units.context: Note tree contextual menu > Available options

units.source: Same as __TRILIUM_PH_0__Insert note after__TRILIUM_PH_1__, but the note will be created as a child of the selected note.
units.context: Note tree contextual menu > Available options

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Move to…__TRILIUM_PH_1__
units.context: Note tree contextual menu > Available options

units.source: Will display a modal to specify where to move the desired notes.
units.context: Note tree contextual menu > Available options

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Clone to…__TRILIUM_PH_1__
units.context: Note tree contextual menu > Available options

units.source: Will display a modal to specify where to __TRILIUM_PH_0__clone__TRILIUM_PH_1__ the desired notes.
units.context: Note tree contextual menu > Available options

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Duplicate__TRILIUM_PH_1__
units.context: Note tree contextual menu > Available options

units.source: Creates a copy of the note and its descendants, placed right after the original.
units.context: Note tree contextual menu > Available options

units.source: When the note has child notes, the item also has an arrow, set apart by a divider. Hovering the item or clicking the arrow opens a submenu:
units.context: Note tree contextual menu > Available options

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Note and its children__TRILIUM_PH_1__ does the same as clicking __TRILIUM_PH_2__Duplicate__TRILIUM_PH_3__.
units.context: Note tree contextual menu > Available options

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__This note only__TRILIUM_PH_1__ copies the note with its content and attributes, but without any of its child notes. Links and relations to the original children keep pointing at them.
units.context: Note tree contextual menu > Available options

units.source: This process is different from __TRILIUM_PH_0__Cloning Notes__TRILIUM_PH_1__ since the duplicated note can be edited independently from the original.
units.context: Note tree contextual menu > Available options

units.source: An alternative to this, if done regularly, would be __TRILIUM_PH_0__Templates__TRILIUM_PH_1__.
units.context: Note tree contextual menu > Available options

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Archive/Unarchive__TRILIUM_PH_1__
units.context: Note tree contextual menu > Available options

units.source: Marks a note as __TRILIUM_PH_0__archived__TRILIUM_PH_1__.
units.context: Note tree contextual menu > Available options

units.source: If the note is already archived, it will be unarchived instead.
units.context: Note tree contextual menu > Available options

units.source: Multiple notes can be selected as well. However, all the selected notes must be in the same state (archived or not), otherwise the option will be disabled.
units.context: Note tree contextual menu > Available options

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Protect subtree/Unprotect subtree__TRILIUM_PH_1__
units.context: Note tree contextual menu > Available options

units.source: On a note that is not protected, __TRILIUM_PH_0__Protect subtree__TRILIUM_PH_1__ marks this note and all of its descendants as protected. On a protected note, the item reads __TRILIUM_PH_2__Unprotect subtree__TRILIUM_PH_3__ and unprotects them instead. See __TRILIUM_PH_4__Protected Notes__TRILIUM_PH_5__ for more information.
units.context: Note tree contextual menu > Available options

units.source: Hovering the item or clicking its arrow opens a submenu with both actions, for instance to unprotect the protected notes below a note that is not protected itself.
units.context: Note tree contextual menu > Available options

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Import into note…__TRILIUM_PH_1__
units.context: Note tree contextual menu > Available options

units.source: Opens the __TRILIUM_PH_0__import__TRILIUM_PH_1__ dialog and places the imported notes as child notes of the selected one.
units.context: Note tree contextual menu > Available options

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Export…__TRILIUM_PH_1__
units.context: Note tree contextual menu > Available options

units.source: Opens the __TRILIUM_PH_0__export__TRILIUM_PH_1__ dialog for the selected notes.
units.context: Note tree contextual menu > Available options

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Search in subtree__TRILIUM_PH_1__
units.context: Note tree contextual menu > Available options

units.source: Opens a full __TRILIUM_PH_0__Search__TRILIUM_PH_1__ with it preconfigured to only look into this note and its descendants (the __TRILIUM_PH_2__Ancestor__TRILIUM_PH_3__ field).
units.context: Note tree contextual menu > Available options

units.source: Advanced options__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: Note tree contextual menu > Advanced options

units.source: The advanced options menu offers some of the less frequently used actions for notes.
units.context: Note tree contextual menu > Advanced options

units.source: To access these options, first look for the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Advanced__TRILIUM_PH_1__ option at the bottom of the contextual menu to reveal a sub-menu with:
units.context: Note tree contextual menu > Advanced options

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Apply bulk actions…__TRILIUM_PH_1__
units.context: Note tree contextual menu > Advanced options

units.source: Opens the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Bulk Actions__TRILIUM_PH_1__ dialog, to apply actions such as adding labels or moving notes to multiple notes at once (see __TRILIUM_PH_2__Multiple selection__TRILIUM_PH_3__).
units.context: Note tree contextual menu > Advanced options

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Edit branch prefix…__TRILIUM_PH_1__
units.context: Note tree contextual menu > Advanced options

units.source: Opens a dialog to assign a name to be able to distinguish __TRILIUM_PH_0__clones__TRILIUM_PH_1__, see __TRILIUM_PH_2__Branch prefix__TRILIUM_PH_3__ for more information.
units.context: Note tree contextual menu > Advanced options

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Convert to attachment…__TRILIUM_PH_1__
units.context: Note tree contextual menu > Advanced options

units.source: Converts the selected notes to __TRILIUM_PH_0__Attachments__TRILIUM_PH_1__ of their parent notes.
units.context: Note tree contextual menu > Advanced options

units.source: This functional is most useful when dealing with image __TRILIUM_PH_0__File__TRILIUM_PH_1__ notes that were imported from an external source or an older version of Trilium.
units.context: Note tree contextual menu > Advanced options

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Expand subtree__TRILIUM_PH_1__
units.context: Note tree contextual menu > Advanced options

units.source: Expands all the child notes in the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Note Tree__TRILIUM_PH_1__.
units.context: Note tree contextual menu > Advanced options

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Collapse subtree__TRILIUM_PH_1__
units.context: Note tree contextual menu > Advanced options

units.source: Collapses all the child notes in the note tree.
units.context: Note tree contextual menu > Advanced options

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Sort by…__TRILIUM_PH_1__
units.context: Note tree contextual menu > Advanced options

units.source: Opens a dialog to sort all the child notes of the selected note.
units.context: Note tree contextual menu > Advanced options

units.source: The sorting is done only once, there is an automatic sorting mechanism as well that can be set using __TRILIUM_PH_0__Attributes__TRILIUM_PH_1__.
units.context: Note tree contextual menu > Advanced options

units.source: See __TRILIUM_PH_0__Sorting Notes__TRILIUM_PH_1__ for more information.
units.context: Note tree contextual menu > Advanced options

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Copy note path to clipboard__TRILIUM_PH_1__
units.context: Note tree contextual menu > Advanced options

units.source: Copies a URL fragment representing the full path to this branch for a note, such as __TRILIUM_PH_0__.
units.context: Note tree contextual menu > Advanced options

units.source: The URL to manually create __TRILIUM_PH_0__Links__TRILIUM_PH_1__ within notes, or for note __TRILIUM_PH_2__Navigation__TRILIUM_PH_3__.
units.context: Note tree contextual menu > Advanced options

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Recent changes in subtree__TRILIUM_PH_1__
units.context: Note tree contextual menu > Advanced options

units.source: This will open __TRILIUM_PH_0__Recent Changes__TRILIUM_PH_1__, but filtered to only the changes related to this note or one of its descendants.
units.context: Note tree contextual menu > Advanced options
